reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing editable conversational roles, binding role prompts to sessions, applying role-owned visuals, and maintaining isolated durable memory with explicit and automatic memory operations.

summaries.zh: 用于管理可编辑的对话角色、会话角色绑定、角色专属视觉效果以及隔离的持久化记忆。
summaries.en: Manages editable conversational roles, session-scoped role bindings, role-owned visuals, and isolated durable memory.

capabilities: Create and edit session-scoped roles with prompts and visual assets
Persist role-scoped durable memory in Markdown files and SQLite
Inject role prompts and memory context into agent sessions
Expose memorize, recall_memory, and forget_memory tools
Store image data through the Harness attachment service
Apply and clean up role-owned theme tokens and visual styles
Optionally call configured extraction and embedding endpoints
